# @stackline/dynamic-dedupe

Install: `npm install @stackline/dynamic-dedupe`
Drop-in alias: `npm install dynamic-dedupe@npm:@stackline/dynamic-dedupe`
Current release: `{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}`
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-dynamic-dedupe
Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/dynamic-dedupe/

Compatibility-first CommonJS module deduplication for copied, linked, and
preserved-symlink dependency trees. API: `activate`, `deactivate`, `reset`.
Zero runtime dependencies. Node 12-24. TypeScript 3.9 and current.

The hook affects CommonJS `require()` only; it is not a native ESM loader.
